text.tspan: Sahra develops spaces that go beyond structure,
focusing on how environments shape everyday life.
Through a careful approach to design, proportion
and materiality, each project is crafted to offer
comfort, continuity and a sense of belonging.
Rather than following trends, Sahra prioritizes
relevant, adaptable and connected to the people
